derivation: The budget-free work class has an exclusive key and empty required_budgets. reserve-a is OPEN holding its key. Every current revocation observation in the supplied authority input reports revoked:true, so its evaluation alone would be AUTHORITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED. RENEW names missing-r, which no reservation has. RESERVATION-RECORDS: missing reservation references in RENEW/RELEASE are admission failures. RES-WIRE-004 fixes the phase-5 code order DEPENDENCY_MISMATCH, EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE, UNSUPPORTED_RELATION, REFERENCE_INVALID, BINDING_MISMATCH, TYPE_INVALID, INPUT_INVALID, LIMIT_EXCEEDED, DEFINITION_CONFLICT, OCCURRENCE_CONFLICT, RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND, ADMINISTRATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED, and RES-003 orders admission phases 1-5 before (6) policy evaluation. AUTHORITY_WITHHELD is a policy decision, so an admission code precedes it. The result is RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND, not WITHHELD. RES-003: an admission refusal creates no receipt and returns the exact supplied state and digest.
